scope: Read-only independent source-byte preservation, lexical theorem/lemma count, and exact declaration-inventory reconciliation. This report does not independently audit statements or rerun Lean.

counting_convention.comments: Inherited lexical convention: remove block comments with /\-.*?\-/ DOTALL, then line comments. Includes explicit private declarations and excludes generated declarations.
counting_convention.exported_declarations: Exact fresh Lean environment inventory. Includes definitions, theorems and generated helpers, not a count of distinct mathematical theorems.

limitations: Theorem-map validation belongs to the separate root check.

Historical readable type strings are unavailable in the fresh inventory schema and are not compared. Shared metadata and exact names are compared; byte-identical source preservation is checked separately.
